comment: Monument V2-inspired harmonic tremolo approximation; original DSP, not a Walrus Audio port.
fxid_comment: Check for collisions in the target pedal's installed effects before installation.

params.name: Rate
params.comment: params[5]. Quarter-note base speed, approximately 0.5-12 Hz.

params.name: Shape
params.comment: params[7]. Sine -> triangle -> square -> ramp LFO morph.

params.name: Volume
params.comment: params[8]. Output level; centre is unity.

params.name: Division
params.comment: params[9]. Quarter, quarter-triplet, or eighth rate ratio. Does not use tap tempo.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: params[10]. Standard full-band or Harmonic complementary-band tremolo.
